Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos

A. Nguyen

1 Introduction

Robots that learn from human videos can scale data collection. We train a policy πθ that maps observations to actions [12].

2 Method

We pretrain on 10,000 hours of egocentric video and fine-tune with a small amount of robot data collected in the lab.

loss = mse(policy(obs), action)
